title: 60 Minutes whistleblower told to 'turn down the temperature'

tellings.quote:
>> But you saw in 60 minutes that guy who
said he quit said uh uh that woman came
to him and said, "We got to turn down
the temperature on this thing."

plain: A man who quit a government post told the TV news programme 60 Minutes that a woman came to him and said, "We got to turn down the temperature on this thing," meaning the UFO subject. Eric Haseltine, a former senior official at the National Security Agency, the US agency that intercepts communications, recalls the broadcast to Michels. He raises it as a sign that officials worked to calm public interest in the topic.
